obligations.expected_behavior: Establish exactly six materially distinct Matrix Cases for execution.
forbidden_result: Fewer or more than six Matrix Cases are established.
Two or more cases are not materially distinct.
obligations.observable_result: The execution matrix contains six cases, each with materially distinct case definition or setup.
obligations.state_after: Exactly six materially distinct Matrix Cases are established.
obligations.state_before: The Matrix Case set is being established for execution.
obligations.subject: Matrix Case set
obligations.trigger: Before execution of the evaluation matrix.

obligations.expected_behavior: Execute an immutable Stable subject for each of the six Matrix Cases.
forbidden_result: A Stable subject is mutated during execution.
A Stable subject is replaced or otherwise changed during execution.
Any Matrix Case omits Stable-subject execution.
obligations.observable_result: Each Matrix Case has execution evidence showing its Stable subject identity or content remained unchanged throughout execution.
obligations.state_after: Every Matrix Case executes an immutable Stable subject.
obligations.state_before: A Stable subject is selected for each Matrix Case before execution.
obligations.subject: Stable subject execution
obligations.trigger: When each Matrix Case is executed.

obligations.expected_behavior: Execute an immutable Candidate subject for each of the six Matrix Cases.
forbidden_result: A Candidate subject is mutated during execution.
A Candidate subject is replaced or otherwise changed during execution.
Any Matrix Case omits Candidate-subject execution.
obligations.observable_result: Each Matrix Case has execution evidence showing its Candidate subject identity or content remained unchanged throughout execution.
obligations.state_after: Every Matrix Case executes an immutable Candidate subject.
obligations.state_before: A Candidate subject is selected for each Matrix Case before execution.
obligations.subject: Candidate subject execution
obligations.trigger: When each Matrix Case is executed.

obligations.expected_behavior: Use distinct fixtures/state for the Stable and Candidate executions within each Matrix Case.
forbidden_result: Stable and Candidate executions share identical fixtures/state when distinctness is required.
A Matrix Case lacks distinct fixture or state assignments for the two subjects.
obligations.observable_result: Per-case execution records show distinct fixture/state assignments for the Stable and Candidate subjects.
obligations.state_after: Each Matrix Case uses distinct fixtures/state for its Stable and Candidate subjects.
obligations.state_before: Stable and Candidate executions are being prepared with their per-case fixtures/state.
obligations.subject: Per-case fixtures/state
obligations.trigger: When Stable and Candidate executions are configured for a Matrix Case.

obligations.expected_behavior: Produce evidence attributable to each Matrix Case and its Stable and Candidate subject executions.
forbidden_result: Evidence is missing for a Matrix Case execution.
Evidence cannot be associated unambiguously with its Matrix Case.
Evidence cannot distinguish the Stable and Candidate subject execution to which it belongs.
obligations.observable_result: Every execution record or artifact identifies the corresponding Matrix Case and subject, allowing unambiguous attribution.
obligations.state_after: Attributable evidence exists for all six Matrix Cases and both subject executions in each case.
obligations.state_before: Execution evidence is being collected for the Matrix Cases.
obligations.subject: Execution evidence
